finding: counter structural 7/7 and counter exact-typed 1/7 reproduce the TZ exactly; additionally lives exact-typed 7/7, fullTypeIdentified 0/7, verified rewards 0, independent confirmations 0, polarity unknown on all 7

finding: all four SHAs exist in the named repositories

finding: 2 of 4 paths implied by the TZ do not exist at the pinned SHA: rcheevos is src/runtime/rc_*.c (not src/rcheevos/*.c) and stable-retro is stable_retro/retro_env.py (package renamed). OCAtari's function lives in scripts/find_causative_ram_full.py. SB3 paths matched.

subject: License review of the four projects

finding: all four are MIT; no incompatibility with GU (MIT); no code copied so no attribution obligation incurred yet

subject: Read SB3 DQN.train against the TZ's Double DQN requirement
finding: SB3's DQN.train at this SHA is VANILLA DQN: the TD target takes max over the target network, and the token 'double' does not occur in the file. NN-01 requires Double DQN, so that target must be written by GU and cannot be described as a port.
limitations: only dqn.py and buffers.py were read

subject: Read the reward source of Stable-Retro
finding: compute_step only delegates; reward and done come from a hand-written per-game scenario manifest (reward.variables/time/script, done.variables). This is per-ROM manual annotation, which 1.3 forbids as a product mechanism, but 11.2 permits for an independent oracle.

subject: Read OCAtari find_causative_ram
finding: It is a RAM-write intervention probe: fixed-seed reset, ale.setRAM(i,v), one step, count changed pixel blocks vs baseline, keep addresses with 2..59 changed blocks. It intervenes on RAM, not on actions as AGOD-05 requires, needs arbitrary core RAM writes, carries a hardcoded game-specific setRAM(123,60), and establishes no goal or polarity.
limitations: upstream behaviour not reproduced; no differential test run

subject: Deterministic restore/replay precondition
command: scratch probe over jsnes toJSON/fromJSON on a controlled cartridge
finding: restore+replay is bit-identical for repeated neutral and repeated action arms, and the action arm differs from neutral; causal probing is therefore possible on this core

subject: Phase-shift confound in naive action-vs-neutral differencing
finding: Holding a button costs CPU time, the game loop misses a vblank and executes fewer iterations, so time-driven bytes are phase-shifted. reset held 12 frames produced exactly the neutral state at 11 frames (frameCounter 85, timer 5, noise 103). A naive difference would have claimed 101 false causal attributions of decoys across the 7 cartridges.
limitations: measured on the synthetic generator family

subject: Causal validation against the independent oracle
finding: 7/7 cartridges: score recovered from the positive button, lives from the negative button, menu from the menu button; all 8 buttons recovered via their own input-echo byte; 0 time-driven decoy attributions; 0 unwired buttons showing any effect beyond their own echo; 0 starts excluded as non-deterministic
limitations: synthetic controlled cartridges only, single-button masks held for the whole window, host only, no polarity/reward inferred, no blind corpus

subject: Resource depletion is observable without an oracle
finding: The negative button decrements lives 3->2->1->0, the value settles at a floor, and once depleted the positive button no longer changes the score. Loss of previously confirmed causal effects is the observable terminal signal.

subject: Polarity induction and phase inference
finding: 7/7 cartridges: NEGATIVE polarity recovered for the correct button; 0/7 accumulators declared POSITIVE or promoted to VERIFIED (blocked by construction); PLAYING 7/7 and DEATH 7/7 recovered
limitations: synthetic cartridges; suppression is judged over a caller-supplied address scope because input echo never stops; separating input plumbing from game state generically is unsolved

subject: Verified reward broker and the UNKNOWN contract
finding: All 8 anti-reward-hacking cases of 6.3 behave as required plus 9 further cases (17 total). UNKNOWN packets carry no value key before or after a JSON round-trip. Intrinsic signals travel on a separate channel with no value key.
limitations: VERIFIED goals are supplied as fixtures: no registry exists yet to produce one, so G3 is advanced but not closed
